root_cause.text: The rtw88 USB driver unnecessarily acquired an extra reference to the USB device via usb_get_dev() during probe, and failed to release that reference on all error paths, causing a device reference leak on probe failure.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states the driver takes a reference to the USB device during probe but does not release it on all probe errors (e.g., when descriptor parsing fails), and the patch removes the usb_get_dev() and usb_put_dev() calls to drop the redundant reference.

candidates.rationale: This call acquires an extra reference to the USB device, which is not released on probe failure paths, causing a reference leak.
This stores the acquired reference in the driver structure, but if probe fails later, the reference remains stored in a structure that may be freed without releasing the reference.

This declares the variable used for error handling; the probe function may set ret to a negative value on error, but the usb_get_dev reference is not released before returning, even though ret indicates failure.
This initializes the rtwusb pointer, which later stores the unreleased reference; if probe fails before cleanup, the structure may be discarded without a usb_put_dev.
This line shows the intended release in the disconnect path, highlighting that no equivalent release exists on probe error paths, confirming the leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This call acquires an extra reference to the USB device via usb_get_dev(). The reference is never released on probe error paths, causing a device reference leak.
This stores the acquired reference in the driver structure. If probe fails later, the stored reference is not released, and the structure may be freed without calling usb_put_dev().
This line in the disconnect path shows the correct release of the USB device reference. Its existence only in disconnect, not in probe error paths, confirms the leak on probe failure.

This initializes the rtwusb pointer which later stores the unreleased USB device reference. If probe fails after this point, the structure holding the reference may be discarded without releasing the reference.

This declares the variable used for error handling. The probe function may set ret to a negative value on error, but the code does not release the USB device reference before returning on such error paths, contributing to the leak.
